$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFKM (AIP France, chart dated 2017-09-14): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Saint-Galmier

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: ATS: NIL. The chart header prints these units to call, which are not services of this aerodrome (its air-air frequency apart): .

AD reserved for ACFT and gliders whose pilots have been recognized fit to use the AD by an instructor (or hold a flight instructor qualification) AD usable by HEL and ULM AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
TKOF and LDG prohibited for motorized ACFT except for emergency landing from 1130 to 1315 and from 1900 to 0800 (SUM: - 1 HR).
Flights of aeroplanes and ULM are prohibited during parachuting.

AD located within CTR SAINT-ETIENNE. a) IFR approach path to Saint-Etienne Loire AD via EB, above R 224. b) Special instruction inside restricted area: 1) inside R 224 (MAX 500 ft ASFC) possible flight on A/A 123.5 and without transponder.

2) to leave R 224, mandatory clearance to enter CTR: signal flight purpose before take off on 119.250, otherwise contact immediately ST ETIENNE TWR after taking off.; stay within R 224 as far as possible until obtaining the clearance to enter CTR.
Activity reserved for authorized pilots and according to the current agreement protocol.
The effective activity is known by SAINT-ETIENNE TWR, CLERMONT INFO, LYON INFO, and MARSEILLE ACC.
Other SKED announced by NOTAM AEM (NR 9905): 500 ft ASFC, during R 224 activation.
